findings.title: local rank1 の null 差が丸めにより unknown になる
findings.requirement: DESIGN.md §8, line 251: null direction has sd0 and band holds; no ridge
findings.impact: Ordinary finite valid local inputs can turn a zero-risk portfolio difference into NaN holdings and invalidate the original-path aggregate study. Existing null fixture uses exactly representable .5 and misses this.
findings.requested_fix: Use stable diffusion-loading/PSD factor evaluation or an explicitly qualified roundoff treatment that preserves raw diagnostics; do not add ridge or repair a materially indefinite covariance. Add the ordinary CS=.6 monthly null fixture.

findings.title: cap 超過の fit を completed と認証する
findings.requirement: DESIGN.md §10, line 282: cap overrun cannot be a member of the completed family; fit docstring includes final diagnostics in cap

evidence.probe: in-memory perf_counter sequence [0,.1,.2,2], one requested/completed update, cap1

findings.impact: A last update or final replay that passes the budget is exported as successful completed training. Downstream use of the advertised complete/status fields can incorrectly accept a capped family. Logging overrun alone does not make these fields consistent.
findings.requested_fix: After final elapsed measurement, downgrade completed/complete on elapsed>cap, while retaining completed update count, last finite weights and overrun. Add deterministic clock coverage for final-update/final-evaluation overrun.
